story.originalTitle: Lawson to replace Hadjar at Red Bull for Dutch GP
story.summaryEn: Red Bull has officially confirmed that Liam Lawson will replace the injured Isack Hadjar at this weekend's Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix. Hadjar sustained a wrist injury during a gym session over the summer shutdown and will therefore miss the race at Zandvoort.
detailZh: 劳森将在红牛顶替哈贾尔出战荷兰大奖赛
哈贾尔因伤将缺席本周末的大奖赛
红牛已正式确认，利亚姆·劳森将在本周末的F1荷兰大奖赛中顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔。
周三上午有消息称，哈贾尔在健身房训练中手腕受伤，因此将缺席赞德沃特站，正式决定即将公布。
这意味着哈贾尔无法在这条迄今为止给他带来唯一一个F1领奖台的赛道上比赛——他在2025年令人印象深刻的新秀赛季中代表小红牛获得第三名。
红牛的一份声明写道：“红牛车队车手伊萨克·哈贾尔在夏季休赛期手腕受伤，将无法参加2026年荷兰大奖赛。”
“我们将迎回利亚姆·劳森，他本周末将驾驶小红牛22顶替出战。车队祝愿伊萨克早日康复，并感谢利亚姆在短时间内挺身而出。”
劳森现在将再次获得成为马克斯·维斯塔潘队友的机会，他曾在2025年前两站担任这一角色，随后被下放回小红牛。
但这位24岁的车手如今更加成熟，本赛季在红牛的姊妹车队表现出色，11站后劳森位列第九，今年迄今为止除三站外均获得积分。
这一消息也意味着劳森在红牛的继任者角田裕毅重返F1，角田去年在维斯塔潘身边表现严重挣扎后，在2026年车手阵容中失去了席位。
小红牛的一份声明写道：“由于伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕受伤，利亚姆·劳森本周末将代表红牛车队出战荷兰大奖赛。”
“由于此次车手变动，储备车手角田裕毅本周末将在赞德沃特代表小红牛出战，与阿尔维德·林德布拉德搭档。”
“我们感谢利亚姆和角田的适应能力，各车队正在为周末做准备，我们祝愿伊萨克早日康复。”
拥有111场大奖赛发车记录的角田，据悉正与Meyer Shank 比赛洽谈2027年的IndyCar席位。
detailEn: Lawson to replace Hadjar at Red Bull for Dutch GP
Hadjar has sustained an injury so will miss this weekend's grand prix
Red Bull has officially confirmed that Liam Lawson will replace the injured Isack Hadjar at this weekend’s Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix.
News emerged on Wednesday morning that Hadjar had sustained a wrist injury from a gym session and was therefore set to skip Zandvoort, with a formal decision impending.
It means Hadjar is unable to compete at the track which has so far given him his only F1 podium, after taking third for Racing Bulls during his impressive rookie campaign in 2025.
A Red Bull statement read: "Red Bull Racing driver Isack Hadjar has sustained a wrist injury during summer shutdown that will prevent him from racing at the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix.
"We will be welcoming back Liam Lawson, who will replace him in RB22 this weekend. The team wishes Isack a speedy recovery and thanks Liam for stepping in on short notice."
Lawson will now receive the opportunity to once again be Max Verstappen’s team-mate, after doing so for the first two rounds of 2025 before being demoted back to Racing Bulls.
But the 24-year-old is now more mature and has impressed with Red Bull’s sister squad this season, as Lawson sits ninth after 11 rounds with points in all but three grands prix so far this year.
This news also means an F1 return for Lawson’s Red Bull successor Yuki Tsunoda, who was left without a seat on the 2026 grid after seriously struggling alongside Verstappen last year.
A Racing Bulls statement read: "Liam Lawson will race for Red Bull Racing at the Dutch Grand Prix this weekend due to Isack Hadjar's wrist injury.
"As a result of the driver change, reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda will race for Racing Bulls in Zandvoort this weekend, alongside Arvid Lindblad.
"We thank both Liam and Yuki for their adaptability as the teams prepare for the weekend and we wish Isack a speedy recovery."
Tsunoda, who has 111 grand prix starts, is understood to be in talks for an IndyCar drive at Meyer Shank Racing in 2027.
keyPointsZh: 哈贾尔在赞德沃特曾于2025年新秀赛季代表小红牛获得个人唯一一个F1领奖台（第三名）。
劳森曾在2025年前两站担任维斯塔潘的队友，后被下放回小红牛，本赛季11站后以第九名、除三站外均得分的成绩表现亮眼。
由于此次车手变动，红牛储备车手角田裕毅将在赞德沃特代表小红牛出战，与阿尔维德·林德布拉德搭档；角田据悉正与Meyer Shank 比赛洽谈2027年IndyCar席位。
keyPointsEn: Hadjar's only F1 podium came at Zandvoort, where he finished third for Racing Bulls during his impressive rookie campaign in 2025.

Lawson previously partnered Max Verstappen for the first two rounds of 2025 before being demoted back to Racing Bulls, and sits ninth after 11 rounds this season with points in all but three grands prix.

As a result of the driver change, Red Bull reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda will race for Racing Bulls in Zandvoort alongside Arvid Lindblad; Tsunoda is understood to be in talks for an IndyCar drive at Meyer Shank Racing in 2027.

relatedItems.summaryZh: F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，26岁的赫塔在从IndyCar转向F2的过程中遇到了比预期更大的困难，但他希望赫塔能够反弹。

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.

赫塔在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛。
keyPointsEn: Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026.
Herta competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016.
